Platform Owner.Title: Data Extraction and Database Creation
Platform Owner.Description: Develop functionality to extract first-level contact information from the platform owner's LinkedIn and Facebook profiles, including personal and professional details to form a comprehensive database.

Platform Owner.Title: Data Enhancement Using AI
Platform Owner.Description: Utilize OpenAI transformers to enhance the extracted data by analyzing and enriching contact profiles with additional details such as personal interests, family information, activities, and travel history.

Platform Owner.Title: Data Analysis for Matching
Platform Owner.Description: Analyze the enhanced data to identify potential targets for specific products or services based on their profiles and interests, as defined by the platform owner.

Platform Owner.Title: Generation of Curated Contact Lists
Platform Owner.Description: Generate curated lists of contacts likely interested in the specific product or service offerings inputted by the platform owner, including contact details and relevant social media profiles.

Platform Owner.Title: Local Data Storage and Management
Platform Owner.Description: Ensure all data is stored locally in JSON files to prioritize privacy and security, with the platform owner responsible for data backup and maintenance.

Platform Owner.Title: User Interface Development
Platform Owner.Description: Develop a simple graphical user interface (GUI) that allows the platform owner to input product or service details, view the generated contact lists, and export these lists to an Excel file.
